question.problem:
Expressed in **ascending order** in degrees, the exact solutions to the equation $\operatorname{cos}⁡(\frac{x}{2}+{30}^{∘})=\frac{1}{2},$ for $-{180}^{∘}\le x<{180}^{∘},$  are

${x}_{1}=$
{{field-1}}${}^{∘},\,{x}_{2}=$
{{field-2}}${}^{∘}.$
question.worked_solution:
We will find the general solution to the equation, and then generate all of the solutions in the required domain.

The general solution to our equation is given by

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{x}{2}+{30}^{∘} & ={60}^{∘}+n\cdot {360}^{∘}, & \, & \, & \frac{x}{2}+{30}^{∘} & ={300}^{∘}+n\cdot {360}^{∘}.\end{aligned}
$$

Solving the two equations above for $x$ gives:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{x}{2} & ={60}^{∘}-{30}^{∘}+n\cdot {360}^{∘} & \, & \, & \frac{x}{2} & ={300}^{∘}-{30}^{∘}+n\cdot {360}^{∘} \\ \frac{x}{2} & ={30}^{∘}+n\cdot {360}^{∘} & \, & \, & \frac{x}{2} & ={270}^{∘}+n\cdot {360}^{∘} \\ x & ={60}^{∘}+n\cdot {720}^{∘} & \, & \, & x & ={540}^{∘}+n\cdot {720}^{∘}\end{aligned}
$$

We set $n=0,\pm 1,\pm 2,…,$ until we have generated all solutions in the domain $-{180}^{∘}\le x<{180}^{∘}.$

- Setting $n=-1$ gives $x=-{660}^{∘}$ and $x=-{180}^{∘}.$  We reject the solution $-{660}^{∘}$ since it lies outside the domain of interest.

- Setting $n=0$ gives $x={60}^{∘}$ and $x={540}^{∘}.$  We reject the solution ${540}^{∘}$ since it lies outside the domain of interest.

All other values of $n$ generate solutions outside the domain $-{180}^{∘}\le x<{180}^{∘}.$ 

So, in ascending order, the solutions are 

$$
{x}_{1}={-180}^{∘},\,{x}_{2}={60}^{∘}.
$$
